## L1: Full 5-timepoint LCTM

This vignette demonstrates fitting the full LCTM with all 5 timepoints
(T1, T2, T4, T5, T6) for the 7 nutritional markers.

```{r eval=FALSE}
data(example_lctm)
fit <- fit_lctm_full(example_lctm, K = 2, n_iter = 1000, seed = 42)
head(fit@posterior)
table(fit@cluster)
```

## Interpretation

- p_VC > 0.5  implies  classified as VC (Vulnerable Class)
- p_RC > 0.5  implies  classified as RC (Resilient Class)
- The model uses ONLY the 7-marker trajectory shape; no baseline covariates.
